Introduction

These are just a few examples of AI tools for kids, that they can use. There are many other great AI tools available, so be sure to explore and find the ones that work best for your child.

Google AI Experiments:

Google AI Experiments is a website with a collection of interactive experiments that kids can use to learn about AI. The experiments cover a variety of topics, such as image recognition, natural language processing, and machine learning. To use Google AI Experiments, simply visit the website and browse the collection of experiments. Click on an experiment to learn more about it and to start using it. https://experiments.withgoogle.com/

Scratch:

Scratch is a programming language and online community where kids can create their own interactive stories, games, and animations. Scratch is a great way for kids to learn about programming and AI concepts. To use Scratch, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then start creating your own projects or browse the community gallery for inspiration. https://scratch.mit.edu/

Code.org:

Code.org is a non-profit organization that aims to make computer science education accessible to everyone. Code.org offers a variety of online courses and tutorials that kids can use to learn about computer science and AI concepts. To use Code.org, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then browse the course catalog and choose a course to start learning. https://code.org/

TensorFlow Play:

TensorFlow Play is a machine learning playground for kids. TensorFlow Play offers a variety of interactive exercises and games that help kids learn about machine learning concepts. To use TensorFlow Play, simply visit the website and start using one of the exercises or games. https://playground.tensorflow.org/

Brainly:

Brainly is a social learning platform where students can ask and answer questions about their schoolwork. Brainly also offers a variety of AI-powered tools that can help students learn, such as a homework helper and a question solver. To use Brainly, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then ask a question or browse the library of questions and answers. https://brainly.com/

Kiddle:

Kiddle is a search engine that is specifically designed for kids. Kiddle filters out inappropriate content and shows kids only websites that are safe and educational. Kiddle also uses AI to provide kids with relevant and interesting search results. To use Kiddle, simply visit the website and enter your search query. https://www.kiddle.co/

Tynker

Tynker is a programming platform that makes it easy for kids to learn to code. Tynker offers a variety of interactive tutorials and projects that kids can use to learn about different programming concepts. Tynker also uses AI to provide kids with personalized feedback and suggestions. To use Tynker, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then start learning to code by completing the tutorials and projects. https://www.tynker.com/

Teachable Machine:

Teachable Machine is a web-based platform that allows kids to create their own machine learning models. Teachable Machine offers a variety of tutorials and exercises that kids can use to learn about machine learning concepts. Kids can then use their knowledge to create their own models to classify images, predict text, and more. To use Teachable Machine, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then start creating your own machine learning models. https://teachablemachine.withgoogle.com/

MIT App Inventor:

MIT App Inventor is a visual programming platform that allows kids to create their own mobile apps. MIT App Inventor uses AI to help kids learn to code and to create apps that are both functional and visually appealing. To use MIT App Inventor, simply visit the website and create an account. You can then start creating your own mobile apps by dragging and dropping blocks of code. https://appinventor.mit.edu/

Lego Mindstorms EV3:

Lego Mindstorms EV3 is a robotics kit that allows kids to build and program their own robots. Lego Mindstorms EV3 uses AI to help kids learn about robotics concepts and to create robots that can perform complex tasks. To use Lego Mindstorms EV3, simply build a robot using the Lego bricks and then program it using the EV3 software. https://education.lego.com/en-us/downloads/mindstorms-ev3/software/
